hints.title: Song Listening Overlap
hints.text: Two users share listening interest if they both listened to the exact same song on the exact same date.

hints.title: Threshold for Recommendations
hints.text: Join the listens table with itself on date and song_id where user1 is distinct from user2, then filter for pairs sharing at least 3 distinct song_ids on that day.

hints.title: Excluding Existing Friendships
hints.text: Ensure the two users are not already connected as friends in the friendship table in either direction.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
WITH DailyListening AS (
    SELECT
        l1.user_id AS user_id,
        l2.user_id AS recommended_id,
        l1.day
    FROM Listens l1
    JOIN Listens l2
        ON l1.day = l2.day
        AND l1.song_id = l2.song_id
        AND l1.user_id != l2.user_id
    GROUP BY l1.user_id, l2.user_id, l1.day
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.song_id) >= 3
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.user_id,
    d.recommended_id
FROM DailyListening d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Friendship f
    WHERE (f.user1_id = d.user_id AND f.user2_id = d.recommended_id)
       OR (f.user1_id = d.recommended_id AND f.user2_id = d.user_id)
);
```

complexity.time: O(L^2) in worst case for self-joining listens on date and song
complexity.space: O(L) auxiliary space for intermediate recommendations
variables: L: number of listening records in Listens table
complexity.notes: Self-join on date and song with distinct song threshold.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Failing to check bidirectional friendship can recommend people who are already friends.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Group by with having filters qualifying pairs before friendship lookup.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle symmetry and verify at least 3 distinct songs on the same day.
